FOUND IN THE ARCHIVES
The art library.
Existing text drawings, collected from the internet. Pick a piece to view, copy, or download.
Original drawings from six collections, including preserved GeoCities galleries. Duplicates merged; artist signatures preserved. Sources & reuse notes ↗


  
HELLO, WORLD.
All you need is a character.
A little tribute to text files, late-night forums, and the beautifully inventive world of early internet art. Inspired by ASCII Art from GameFAQs by Lock Books.
[01] FIND A CLASSIC
Search a subject like “skull,” then cycle through every matching piece or open the gallery. The archive displays existing ASCII drawings as text, preserving their characters and signatures.
[02] MAKE SOMETHING NEW
Enter “Text: HELLO” to generate a banner, or upload an image and turn it into a grid of characters. Adjust detail, character set, and contrast to find your texture.
[03] TAKE IT WITH YOU
Copy a piece or download TXT, PNG, or SVG. Archive exports include their source. Use a monospace font to keep everything lined up.
The archive combines six online and historical collections in a searchable local catalog. Use the collection filter to explore each source. It is a dated snapshot, not a live search of every ASCII site. New artwork is generated from your images or text; free-form AI generation is not connected. Images are processed on your device. Source and reuse information.
